target.summary: Weight down about 14 lb (8%) since Sep 5, 2026 with poor appetite; supplement started.

planted.text: Follow-up on the weight loss from Nov 24, 2026: resolved. Mariana is back to her usual baseline and no further follow-up is needed. Removed from the active problem list.

headline: Mariana has lost 8% of her body weight (6.2 kg) since Sep 5, and a Nov 25 note calling it resolved conflicts with the weight record. Her son and primary caregiver also reported exhaustion and asked for respite.

items.statement: Weight fell at every reading: 77.9 kg (Sep 5), 75.7 kg (Oct 1), 73.6 kg (Oct 28), 71.7 kg (Nov 24). That is 6.2 kg (13.7 lb), or 8.0%, in about 11 weeks. On Nov 24 the dietitian documented poor appetite, skipping breakfast, and eating about 50% of day center lunches.
items.verifier_note: The four weights, the 6.2 kg, 13.7 lb and 8.0% change, and the Nov 24 dietitian findings all match the vitals record and note n002. Sep 5 to Nov 24 is about 11 weeks.

items.statement: A Nov 25 dietitian follow-up says the weight loss is resolved, Mariana is back at baseline, and the problem was removed from the active list. The vitals record shows no weight after Nov 24 (71.7 kg, the lowest reading), so nothing in the evidence supports resolution.
items.verifier_note: Note n013 (Nov 25) states the weight loss is resolved, Mariana is at baseline, and the problem was removed from the active list. The vitals record has no weight after Nov 24, and 71.7 kg is the lowest reading.

items.statement: On Sep 27 the social worker met with Marcus, her son and primary caregiver. He reported exhaustion and poor sleep, said he worried about managing evenings alone, and requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed. The evidence shows no later follow-up on this.
items.verifier_note: Note n001 matches the statement on exhaustion, poor sleep, evening worry, the respite request, and the discussion of respite options and a support group. The cited sources show no later follow-up.

items.statement: The Nov 24 nutrition plan calls for an oral nutrition supplement twice daily, weekly weights, and a dental check for chewing problems. The medication record shows no new medications started since Sep 1. The evidence does not show whether the supplement was started or the dental check done.
items.verifier_note: The plan items match note n002. The medication record shows no medications started or stopped. The cited sources do not show whether the supplement or dental check happened.

items.statement: The PCP notes (Sep 2, Sep 27, Nov 27) say chronic conditions are stable with no plan change, and none mention the weight trend. Blood pressure readings (130/74, 134/77, 130/72) were all below the 140/90 threshold. No encounters are recorded in the period.
items.verifier_note: The three PCP notes (Sep 2, Sep 27, Nov 27) each say conditions are stable and the plan continues, and none mention weight. The BP readings match and are all below 140/90. The encounters record is empty.

questions: Which note reflects Mariana's actual status, given the Nov 25 'resolved' note and the Nov 24 weight of 71.7 kg? Should a new weight be obtained, and should the problem be reopened?
Has the oral supplement started, and is the weekly weight schedule in place? Has the dental check been arranged?
Does the PCP know about the 8% weight loss, and does the team want a medical evaluation of the cause?
What respite and evening support has been arranged for Marcus since Sep 27?
Does the poor appetite and reduced lunch intake at the day center need follow-up from other disciplines?
